text:
alex: CI on main turned red on linux-x64, test shared_kv_prefetch_test failing ~1/12 runs. can someone kick a rerun? logs show cache mismatch + a timer expiry.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by alex — job 4832110001. starting matrix rebuild.
maya: thanks — i'll watch the rerun. quick paste of the failing log we saw:
```
E shared_kv_prefetch_test.cpp:142: Assertion `cache.size() == expected` failed
WARN prefetch_timer: expired after 120ms (expected < 100ms)
Stack: runtime::fetch_prefetch -> scheduler::enqueue -> timer::fire
```
alex: interesting that timer drift shows up. this test stubs time but we might be hitting real scheduler jitter under load.
ryan: i pushed a micro-optimization to the allocator last week (PR #2981). it touches hot paths but not the timer. still, could change interleaving.
jin: fwiw, i've seen this locally when background GC spikes. are we running any noisy jobs on the runner?
sam: ci-bot just posted: job 4832110001 finished — flaky failure reproduced on node-5. attaching the node label and raw output: https://ci.internal/4832110001/output
alex: thanks — can someone start a bisect? i can only spare a small window today. preference: quick binary search over last 40 commits that touched runtime/allocator or runtime/scheduler.
maya: @ryan can you bisect range 2634..2981? you authored many of those. i'll coordinate reruns. :eyes:
ryan: on it. starting bisect script now: `./tools/ci-bisect --range 2634:2981 --test shared_kv_prefetch_test --platform linux-x64`
ci-bot: Bisect job queued 4832110022. will run parallel builds across 4 workers.
alex: small repro idea: add temporary extra logging around prefetch timer to capture wall-clock vs stubbed time. that might show mismatch without full bisect.
jin: agree, adding logs is quick. i'll open a tiny PR with logging so bisect artifacts are more useful.
sam: also, can we try forcing single-threaded runner to see if scheduling noise is the culprit? quick patch: `--ci-runner-threads=1` on the bisect jobs?
ryan: adding that flag to the bisect job. starting sub-bisect with single-threaded runs.
ci-bot: Worker 2 reproduced failure at commit 2748.
maya: nice, narrowing. 2748 touched timer backoff constants in scheduler.cpp.
alex: that matches hypothesis. ryan — can you pull the diff for 2748 and run local stress with `--ci-runner-threads=1` + `--repeat 100`?
ryan: running now. if i can repro locally i'll try a minimal fix or rollback.
jin: if the fix is nondeterministic, we should also add a deterministic seed to the test and record it in the CI artifacts to make future flake triage faster.
alex: agreed — cc @oncall-bot for visibility and to track an incident if we need a rollback to keep main green.
oncall-bot: Incident created: #INF-2026-117 (flaky shared_kv_prefetch_test). Severity: low. Assignee: eng-runtime oncall.
maya: summary action items: 1) ryan to confirm local repro at 2748, 2) jin to add extra logging PR, 3) add deterministic seed to test if fix isn't immediate, 4) optional rollback if bisect shows regression introduced by 2748.
ryan: local stress repro hit failure 2/100 with same assertion. will try a quick revert of the backoff tweak to validate.
alex: thanks all. keep updates here — if anyone finds an immediate mitigation to keep CI green, post it and i'll land it. :shipit:
maya: landing jin's logging PR now so subsequent runs have better traces.
ci-bot: logging PR merged and bisect rerun scheduled as job 4832110058.
sam: good progress — i'll follow up tomorrow with a postmortem blurb and add the test to flaky-tests-monitor if we end up needing a longer-term mitigation. :thumbsup:
